parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the internal energy of a system.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Explain, by reference to work done and heating, whether the internal energy of the following increases, decreases or remains constant:

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: the gas in a toy balloon when the balloon bursts suddenly,

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: ice melting at constant temperature and at atmospheric pressure to form water that is more dense than the ice.
